data.name: Eustacia
data.gender_notes: Eustacia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin eustatia, meaning 'eastern' or 'fruitful' or 'prosperity'. In Christian tradition, Eustacia is a name of the Virgin Mary, signifying the eternal prosperity she bestows upon her children. The name Eustacia carries the meaning “Eternal prosperity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eustacia usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Eustacia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Eternal prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eustacia total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אוסטקיה

in_greek.name: Εὐστακία
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εὐστακία προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις 'εὐ' που σημαίνει 'καλός' και 'στακίς' που σημαίνει 'σταχυς' ή 'καρπός', και 'κία' που σημαίνει 'δύναμις' ή 'ισχύς', που σημαίνει 'καλή στακίς' ή 'αγαθή δύναμις', και συμβολίζει την πνευματική καρποφορία και την αγαθή δύναμη.

in_latin.name: Eustacia
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Eustacia is derived from Greek roots meaning 'well-grafted' or 'fruitful', conveying the idea of spiritual fruitfulness and good power, reflecting the Christian virtue of bearing good fruit in one's life.

in_english.name: Eustacia
in_english.long_meaning: The name Eustacia originates from Greek roots, signifying 'fruitful' or 'well-grafted', and conveys the idea of bearing abundant spiritual fruit, symbolizing a life of virtue and righteousness in Christian tradition.
